# Style index · 风格索引

Users may name a style in English, in Chinese, by a name it had before (Formerly), or by its folder. Find it here, then read `styles/<folder>/STYLE.md`.
用户可能用英文名、中文名、曾用名或文件夹名来指定风格。在这里查到文件夹，再读 `styles/<文件夹>/STYLE.md`。
